method: Opaque sRGB bytes; no resizing, alignment, masks, estimator or pixelmatch. Exact nonzero and max-channel delta > 40 are distinct metrics. Dimension mismatches have null pixel metrics. Fixed 32px tile concentration and symmetric radius-1px nearest-colour residual are exploratory independent diagnostics, not acceptance thresholds.
acceptance: A positive fail-min minus pass-max gap is necessary but not sufficient for a robust scalar classifier. Overlap remains unresolved; never relax expected.json or remove knownRedIssue to certify separation.
